attribution.text: DossierFacile est le dossier de location numérique de l'Etat. Entièrement gratuit, conforme et sécurisé, il protège les locataires et rassure les propriétaires.

retention.covers: A tenant's file and what was read of it: three months at most from when it was obtained (P3M, 89 days at its shortest), none once the applicant revoked the access

provenance.notes: Partners only: the partner charter signed, a security assurance plan and terms of use with a privacy policy for DossierFacile Connect (commercial use, caching and storage declared 'contract'). Retention: a file is kept three months at most from when it was obtained (P3M), and not at all once the applicant revoked the access; declared as rights.retention at their shortest span, 89 days (7,689,600 s), which also bounds a cached answer (omnisense/contracts 9a96e22: cacheTtl() never longer than the retention); caching.maxTtl, where the three months were declared before the schema had a retention, sets no bound of its own: the terms bound how long the file is kept, not how long an answer is served again. Documents are read at DossierFacile, watermarked, never copied, only while the file is VALIDATED; the link to a file is never shown to a third party without the applicant's consent; the service is never offered to a third party for a fee (redistribution forbidden); a refusal of a validated file is motivated and reported. The Connect button with DossierFacile's text is shown. Price: free. Rate limits: none published (unknown).
